title.zh: 乘法的面积模型 · 交换律与分配律
title.en: Multiplication as area · commutative and distributive laws

description.zh: a × b 就是 a 行 b 列方格的总数，也就是长方形的面积：转个方向面积不变（交换律），切一刀分成两块再相加（分配律），两位数乘法的竖式就是把一块地切成四块分别算。
description.en: a × b is the number of squares in a rows of b columns — the area of a rectangle: turning it round leaves the area unchanged (the commutative law), cutting it in two and adding the pieces is the distributive law, and the written method for two-digit multiplication computes the four pieces of one cut-up plot.

zh: 竖式乘法为什么是对的

reason.zh: 12 × 13 按位值拆成 (10 + 2) × (10 + 3)，横竖各切一刀得到四块；整十那块最好算，竖式的每一行就是其中一块或几块。
reason.en: Place value splits 12 × 13 into (10 + 2) × (10 + 3), and one cut each way gives four blocks; the tens block is the easiest, and each line of the written method is one or more of those blocks.

label.zh: 先知道面积数的是方格

reason.zh: 面积是铺满图形要多少个单位方格，长方形面积等于长 × 宽；有了这一点，才能把“一圈有多长”和“里面有多大”分成两本账。
reason.en: Area is how many unit squares fill a shape, and a rectangle’s is length × width; with that in hand, “how long around” and “how big inside” can be kept as two separate ledgers.

reason.zh: 已知面积 24 反过来找边长，就是问 24 能不能平均排成几行；排不整齐时最后一行排不满，多出来的那几格就是余数。
reason.en: Working back from an area of 24 to its sides asks whether 24 can be laid out in equal rows; when it cannot, the last row is incomplete, and the squares left over in it are the remainder.
